records.claim: Patients meeting any of the following criteria should NOT be considered for SYMLIN therapy: • poor compliance with current insulin regimen. • poor compliance with prescribed self blood glucose monitoring. • have a HbA1c >9%. • recurrent severe hypoglycemia requiring assistance during the past 6 months. • presence of hypoglycemia unawareness. • confirmed diagnosis of gastroparesis. • require the use of drugs that stimulate gastrointestinal motility. • pediatric patients.
records.source_title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use SYMLIN safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for SYMLIN. SYMLIN ® (pramlintide acetate) injection for subcutaneous use Initial U.S. Approval: 2005
